program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row))
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[marker_row]):
        if value in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            for r in range(marker_row - height, marker_row):
                out[r][c] = 1
            out[marker_row - height][c] = value
    return out
'''
